verdict: Google Business profile is your only active channel — and it stalled this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all engagement came through your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google carried zero spend and produced zero leads this period. The profile generated 42 total actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) across the full window, but activity dropped 87% in the most recent 7 days versus the 7 days before, including three consecutive days of zero actions. Your website saw 191 sessions this period — up 19% week over week — but recorded no conversions, so visitors are arriving and not reaching out. We're investigating the profile drop now and reviewing the website path to understand where interest is being lost before any paid campaigns are turned on.
